title: Home
persona.inCall: A call is in progress: switch personas after it ends.
ready.title: Readiness
ready.restart: Saved settings wait for a restart.
ready.mcpRestart: The MCP server still serves the settings it started with.
ready.keys.missing: Missing keys: {names}. Calls can't start without them.
ready.voice.none: She has no voice yet. Calls can't start until she has one.
ready.voice.bad: Fish Audio can't use her voice ({id}): it is private or gone.
ready.voice.badEnv: Fish Audio can't use the voice FISH_VOICE_ID sets ({id}). Change it in the environment.
ready.voice.unchecked: Her voice ({id}) hasn't been checked with Fish Audio yet.
ready.voice.ok: Her voice works with Fish Audio.
ready.voice.env: Her voice comes from FISH_VOICE_ID in the environment.
ready.memory.off: Memory is off: she won't remember you between calls.
ready.memory.down: Qdrant isn't answering, so memory is off for now.
ready.memory.unchecked: Memory is set up, but Qdrant hasn't been checked yet.
ready.facts.none: No facts index yet: she knows only her prompt.
ready.facts.stale: Her facts index was built with other embedding settings and needs building again.
ready.streams.none: No stream archive yet: she can't recall past broadcasts.
ready.streams.stale: Her stream archive was built with other embedding settings and needs building again.
ready.streams.noCatalog: Her stream archive is built, but the broadcast overview isn't.
ready.selfies.none: No outfit references, so she can't take selfies.
ready.ytdlp.onFirstDownload: yt-dlp installs itself on the first download.
ready.ytdlp.unavailable: yt-dlp is unavailable, so videos can't be downloaded. Install it with brew install yt-dlp or pip install yt-dlp: Eidolon then uses the one on your PATH.
ready.ffmpeg.missing: ffmpeg isn't installed. Only videos over 5 hours need it: brew install ffmpeg, apt install ffmpeg or winget install ffmpeg.
ready.disk.low: Only {free} free on the data home's disk. Downloaded audio takes a lot of space.
ready.disk.ok: {free} free on the data home's disk.
ready.lastError: The last call ended with an error ({when}).
